title: Integrate selected tests

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 selected-test capability assessment for the exact current admitted accelerator source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current accelerator forest already supplies a dedicated, versioned selected-test authority: AffectedCheckSelector@1 deterministically expands supplied exact dependency edges and falls back when uncertain; DatasetsVerificationInputAdapter@1 maps reviewed validation IDs to exact pytest node IDs or requires broader selection; and PytestVerificationAdapter@1 binds explicit pytest argv, selector, configuration, fixture, and environment CIDs before executing. The declared-output boundary permits only this receipt, so no duplicate selector, test runner, or PCSM-only test package was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The reusable selected-test components and their current-head positive/negative tests are available, but an actual PCSM selection cannot be bound to a canonical current aggregate source-map CID or canonical CodeIR/source identity. The required PCSM suite covers structured decoding, not selected-test integration. This receipt therefore records the qualified reusable capability without authorizing promotion, mutation, or a claim that a PCSM current-forest test selection has run.

evidence_legend.measured: Observed directly from the named current source forest or the authoritative sealed validation environment.
evidence_legend.estimated: A calculated approximation; it cannot establish selector behavior, current-tree identity, CID binding, or test success.
evidence_legend.simulated: A controlled provider-environment execution; it cannot replace sealed validation or authorize promotion.
evidence_legend.unavailable: A required identity, capability, or result absent from the authoritative environment; it is neither zero nor passing.

freshness_check.method: Compared outer HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; compared each admitted nested HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; inspected outer and direct admitted nested porcelain before receipt creation; enumerated the required-test root; recorded selected implementation/test Git blobs and SHA-256 values; searched the exact PCSM implementation/test roots for current source-map contract identifiers; and used fresh private HOME directories under the prescribed sealed PATH for validation.
freshness_check.result: The dispatch tree equals outer HEAD^{tree}; each recorded nested commit/tree pair equals its checked-out head; the inspected outer and direct admitted nested worktrees were clean before receipt creation; the required test root contains one PCSM structured-decoding module; and the exact accelerator PCSM roots contain no SourceMapResolver@1, SourceLinkReceipt@1, aggregate source-map, or source_map_resolver identifier.
freshness_check.invalidates_on: Any change to a bound commit/tree, gitlink head/tree, scheduler digest, listed source digest, required-test topology/result, selected-test contract, or current source-map contract/CID requires a fresh receipt.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No current-tree aggregate PCSM source-map CID or canonical CodeIR/source identity to exact current file/node/span resolution is present in the task-owned PCSM implementation/test roots. The prior PCSM-057 assessment was consulted and this receipt independently repeated the current-head absence search. Git trees, blobs, validation IDs, and local pytest node IDs are not substitutes for canonical PCSM identity.

components.role: Pure deterministic affected-test/static/type/proof selection from supplied semantic and dependency edges. Output is lexicographically stable and uncertain, opaque, dynamic, uncovered, truncated, conflicting, or incomplete inputs require broader or full-suite fallback.
Non-authoritative adapter that sorts/deduplicates validation IDs, accepts only exact pytest node shapes, and marks missing or malformed mappings as requiring broader selection.

Builds explicit python -m pytest argv and rejects a selector CID mismatch; its request/receipt contracts bind selector argv, configuration bytes, fixture bytes, environment observation, and applicable repository-tree CID inputs before execution.

cid_binding.profile: The pytest adapter computes and verifies selector CID inputs from exact argv and requires configuration, fixture, and environment CID bindings. The generic selector is non-authoritative and intentionally does not promote opaque repository_tree_id values to receipt repository_tree_cid values.
cid_binding.current_pcsm_execution_binding: unavailable because the required canonical PCSM source-map/CID inputs are absent; no selected PCSM test execution is represented as having occurred.

selected_existing_authority.authority_boundary: All datasets adapter outputs are non-authoritative. Selection does not execute tests or invent exact coverage, and the pytest adapter produces evidence only after its contract bindings validate. Neither component grants model output mutation authority.

source_inventory.role: Deterministic exact/broader/full-suite selected-test policy and reason-chain implementation.
Versioned validation-ID to exact pytest-node mapping and fail-closed broader-selection observation.
Versioned pytest execution adapter with explicit argv and selector/configuration/fixture/environment binding checks.
Dedicated positive and negative selected-test behavior coverage.
Exact mapping and malformed/missing-mapping broader-selection coverage.
Positive and negative pytest execution, selector-CID, and terminal-status projection coverage.
Only module reached by the required PCSM symlinked suite; its result is recorded separately and is not relabelled as selected-test integration coverage.

positive_coverage: Direct and transitive symbol/path, fixture, and configuration edges choose affected pytest nodes without choosing unrelated tests.
Selection order and reason chains are deterministic; selector object and function output round-trip identically.
Reviewed validation IDs map to sorted exact pytest node IDs, and explicit python -m pytest selected-node and full-suite argv are reproducible.
Selector, configuration, fixture, and environment bindings are retained in a passing pytest receipt.
negative_coverage: Opaque, dynamic, unknown, uncovered, truncated, conflicting, and incomplete validation mappings force broader or full-suite selection instead of being claimed exact.
Malformed mappings and non-pytest node shapes are rejected to unmapped IDs; opaque repository tree IDs remain distinct from receipt tree CIDs.

Empty selected-node input, selector CID mismatch, timeouts, cancellation, unavailable executables, setup/teardown failure, XPASS, collection failure, malformed reports, unmodeled skips/XFAILs, and simulated mode cannot produce a production passing result.

limitations: This exact-output dispatch is receipt-only. It selects and validates an existing current-head authority but does not modify accelerator implementation/tests or create a competing selected-test subsystem.

AffectedCheckSelector operates only on supplied edges and catalog data; it does not discover or invent semantic/test dependencies and remains non-authoritative until a separately admitted consumer supplies canonical bindings.
The datasets adapter's opaque repository_tree_id and local pytest node IDs are deliberately not canonical PCSM source identities or receipt repository-tree CIDs.
The required PCSM suite passed but covers structured decoding only; it cannot be relabelled as selected-test integration validation.
No model output is accepted as evidence or mutation authority, and no M2/M3 mutation, generated-source mutation, automatic source materialization, or promotion is authorized.
The receipt has no immutable self-CID because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.

rollback.procedure: Revert only this receipt and invalidate consumers of this current-head selected-test capability assessment. Do not alter protected planning documents, existing verification components, or unrelated admitted history.
rollback.freshness_requirement: Do not reuse this receipt after any bound tree, gitlink, source digest, scheduler binding, required-test topology/result, selected-test contract, or PCSM source-map capability change.
